subject: spanish
title: Numbers 1 to 20
final_note: Numbers unlock prices, ages and dates.

walkthroughs.body_html: Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho, nueve, diez. Practise saying them aloud daily.
The first teens have their own names: once (11), doce (12), trece (13), catorce (14), quince (15).
From 16 they use 'ten and.': diecisesis (16), diecisiete (17), dieciocho (18), diecinueve (19), veinte (20).

mcqs.q: Which preposition expresses 'for' as duration (e.g., 'for two hours')?
Where do most descriptive adjectives go relative to the noun?
options: Either position with the same meaning.
Before the noun, as in English.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I study English at school' in Spanish?
options: Either position with the same meaning.
Estudio el inglés a la escuela.
